hints.title: Chronological Event Ordering
hints.text: The friendship events are not guaranteed to be ordered by time. Sort them by timestamp first.

hints.title: Component Count Tracking
hints.text: Initially there are n isolated individuals. Merging two previously disjoint groups decrements the component count by one.

hints.title: Single Component Trigger
hints.text: As soon as the number of connected components drops to 1, return the timestamp of that event. If logs conclude with multiple components, return -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking full graph connectivity after every single edge takes O(M * (N + M)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint Set Union with path compression maintains component counts in near-constant amortized time per log entry.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify sorting followed by DSU component reduction to 1 as the optimal pattern.
complexity.notes: Inverse Ackermann alpha(N) is practically bounded by 4 for all realistic inputs.
